latestVersion.changelog:
- Minimum CLI version updated to aliyun CLI ≥ 3.3.3; now requires updating via a provided script and plugin update step.
- Introduced mandatory enable/disable of AI-mode for all Agent Skill invocations using specific CLI commands before/after any workflow.
- All aliyn CLI commands must now use the explicit user agent: AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-sas-install-agent.
- Expanded CLI setup and exit protocol; AI-mode must be explicitly disabled at every exit point, covering all workflow outcomes.
- Documentation and references updated to reflect stricter environment checks and CLI operational flow requirements.
